scope: Source-side native crop and display preview for the existing CMA radar preview domain; not Forecast renderer integration

crop.method: Contiguous native-grid slice covering every source cell intersecting the requested viewport; no regridding or interpolation
crop.verification: Saved lat, lon and z were fully reopened and compared with the in-memory source slice using exact array equality

display.resampling: Nearest native cell at each display-pixel centre
display.normalization: Linear -10000 to 8500 m; explicit color change around 0 m; no hillshade

checks.visual_review: passed by implementer at full 1800x1500 resolution: terrain, bathymetry, zero break, coordinates and WMO boundaries readable; no text overlap or clipping

limitations: PNG display sampling is not a scientific resampling product; use the regional NetCDF for values.
Blue means elevation below zero, not a separately validated land/sea mask.
WMO overlay uses locally mirrored vector geometry and does not include official place-name labels.
No independent review, radar overlay, terrain adapter or production integration is claimed.
